modelFront.evidence: Rebuilt QSC K12.2 (public/assets/qsc-k12-2.glb) (pipeline model with the tekpractice extras): its I/O face, the connectors and the port_* empties sit at glTF +z (tests/assets/modelFront.test.ts asserts every empty within the jack recess of the +z face), so the baffle is the opposite face, glTF -z, which the scene's z mirror sends to Babylon +z at yaw 0 where the acoustics aim. DeviceSpawner turns nothing for a pipeline model and reports -z whatever the axis says; the field stays so that the device counts as having an established front (coverage verified). Replaces the legacy-scan measurement (2026-11-10).

rules.title: Connector mismatch
rules.check: The two connectors must physically mate (connectorTypes.matesWith).
rules.teach: An XLR male mates an XLR female; a TT plug mates a TT jack. If it doesn't fit, it isn't the right cable — never force it.
rules.teach_fr: Un XLR mâle s’emboîte dans un XLR femelle ; une fiche TT s’emboîte dans un jack TT. Si ça ne rentre pas, ce n’est pas le bon câble : il ne faut jamais forcer.

rules.title: Signal type mismatch
rules.check: Source and destination signal types must be compatible: mic→mic-pre, line→line, digital→same digital format, pro (+4 dBu) vs consumer (-10 dBV) flagged.
rules.teach: A mic into a line input is 40 dB too quiet; line into a mic-pre clips; AES3 into an analog input is just noise; consumer gear into pro gear runs 12 dB low.
rules.teach_fr: Un micro sur une entrée ligne est trop faible de 40 dB ; une ligne sur un préampli micro sature ; de l’AES3 dans une entrée analogique ne donne que du bruit ; du matériel grand public relié à du matériel pro sort 12 dB plus bas.

rules.title: Direction mismatch
rules.check: An output must feed an input (out→in). out→out and in→in are invalid; bidir ports accept either end.
rules.teach: Signal flows one way: source → destination. Two outputs fighting each other can damage gear.
rules.teach_fr: Le signal circule dans un seul sens : source → destination. Deux sorties qui se battent peuvent endommager le matériel.

rules.title: Phantom power (+48 V)
rules.check: A port flagged requiresPhantom must reach an input flagged providesPhantom with phantom enabled (error if missing). Warning if +48 V is enabled toward a ribbon/line source.
rules.teach: Condensers (U 87) are silent without +48 V. Dynamics (SM58, RE20) ignore it. Vintage ribbons can be damaged by it.
rules.teach_fr: Les micros à condensateur (U 87) restent muets sans alimentation fantôme +48 V. Les micros dynamiques (SM58, RE20) l’ignorent. Les micros à ruban d’époque peuvent être endommagés par elle.

rules.title: ON-AIR tally light
rules.check: When a mic fader is open on a broadcast console, its GPIO tally output must drive an ON-AIR light (isOnAirTally chain complete).
rules.teach: The red light is a safety contract: open mic = ON-AIR lit, or someone will walk in talking during the news.
rules.teach_fr: Le voyant rouge est un contrat de sécurité : micro ouvert = ON-AIR allumé, sinon quelqu’un entrera en parlant pendant le journal.

rules.title: Monitor mute on open mic (feedback)
rules.title_fr: Coupure des écoutes sur micro ouvert (larsen)
rules.check: Opening a mic in the same room as active monitor outputs (isMonitorOut) must mute those monitors, else feedback loop detected.
rules.teach: Studio speakers + open mic = larsen. Broadcast consoles mute the control-room monitors automatically when your mic is open.
rules.teach_fr: Enceintes de studio + micro ouvert = larsen. Les consoles de diffusion coupent automatiquement les écoutes de la régie quand un micro est ouvert.

rules.title: Mix-minus / N-1 return echo
rules.check: The feed sent to a remote codec must be the program MINUS the codec's own return (N-1). If the return is present in its own send, echo is detected.
rules.teach: Send a guest their own voice back and they hear themselves delayed — unusable. Every duplex needs an N-1 bus.
rules.teach_fr: Renvoyer à un invité sa propre voix, c’est la lui faire entendre en différé : inutilisable. Tout duplex a besoin d’un bus N-1.

rules.title: Word clock master/slave & sample rate
rules.title_fr: Word clock maître/esclave et fréquence d’échantillonnage
rules.check: Every digital audio connection needs exactly one clock master upstream; slaves lock to it. Two masters, no master, or mismatched sample rates on a link are errors.
rules.teach: Digital audio without a shared clock = clicks and pops. One master (OCX HD or the interface), everyone else slaves.
rules.teach_fr: Un audio numérique sans horloge commune = des clics et des craquements. Un seul maître (l’OCX HD ou l’interface), tous les autres en esclave.
